description:
Source code, results and figures for SDF-Aware Weighting (SAW), an adaptive eikonal regularisation scheme for three-dimensional level-set physics-informed neural networks. The accompanying manuscript is titled "SDF-Aware Weighting: Adaptive Eikonal Regularisation for Three-Dimensional Level-Set Physics-Informed Neural Networks" by Muhammad Akbar Khan and Fahim Raees.

SAW applies a residual-quantile gate before gradient-norm balancing so that legitimate departures from the signed-distance property are not incorrectly treated as network error. The repository evaluates four three-dimensional benchmarks: a translating sphere, rotating sphere, Zalesak slotted sphere and reversed single vortex.

Contents. Training and evaluation code for all four benchmarks; fixed-weight sweeps; SAW runs at q = 0.95 and gate-off controls; ablations and diagnostics; WENO5 + TVD-RK3 baseline results; complete result tables; and publication figures. See README.md for installation, training, evaluation and reproduction instructions.

Version 1.2.0 corresponds to the release accompanying the manuscript and includes the complete source code, results and figures used in the reported analyses.
